name: io.github.Sandeeprdy1729/timps
description: Persistent memory with contradiction detection, burnout monitoring, and 69 intelligence tools.

environmentVariables.description: URL of the TIMPS MemoryServer (e.g. http://localhost:4100). If not set, uses local file-based memory.
environmentVariables.name: TIMPS_URL

environmentVariables.description: URL of the TIMPS MemoryServer for memory operations. Set to same as TIMPS_URL when using the full stack.
environmentVariables.name: TIMPS_MEMORY_URL

environmentVariables.description: API key for authenticating with TIMPS MemoryServer. Generate via POST /auth/key on the server.
environmentVariables.name: TIMPS_API_KEY

environmentVariables.description: Project path for local memory storage. Defaults to current working directory.
environmentVariables.name: TIMPS_PROJECT_PATH
